notes: Primary C instrument (RESEARCH.md §1.1). Runtime argv relationship only: invoked as an independent program, never vendored or linked (NOTICE). The range pins the anchored 9.8 development tree measured 2026-09-28 (budget.py); upstream's latest tagged release at survey time was v9.7, so 9.8dev is the deliberate anchor and the eventual 9.8 release stays in range. Output contract: stderr summary stream is the primary parse source; -b jsonv1 is opportunistic because the anchored build has a measured -o EINVAL defect (cli.py probe_hydra_output). Flag policy (budget.py): -C explicit pairs only, -K -I -f required, -e forbidden (attempt multiplier). requires_standard_ports is false: -s/--service port overrides let the lab fixture serve http-get on loopback:8080.
